 except Exception as error:
  observed.append({'case':name,'error':type(error).__name__+': '+str(error),'expected':expected,'correct':False})
print('public_hamming_observations',json.dumps(observed,sort_keys=True))
assert all(row['correct'] for row in observed),observed
